INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT: DR. ARLO KAUFMAN
Case: Helios Pharma Trial HL-902
Interviewer: Regulatory Auditor Sarah Jenkins
Interviewee: Dr. Arlo Kaufman, Principal Investigator

[09:00 AM] JENKINS: Dr. Kaufman, were all Phase 2 sample vials kept at minus 80 Celsius continuously?
[09:00 AM] KAUFMAN: Yes, absolutely. Freezer Unit 4 maintained strict minus 80 Celsius throughout the August testing window.
[09:01 AM] JENKINS: Did any power outage affect the cold storage?
[09:01 AM] KAUFMAN: There was zero temperature excursion. The backup diesel generator kicked in seamlessly during the August 14 storm.
[09:02 AM] JENKINS: When were the efficacy blood draws sent to the central reference lab?
[09:02 AM] KAUFMAN: They were dispatched via CryoExpress courier on August 16 at 08:00 AM under dry ice.

raw_text:
INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT: PRIYA SHARMA
Case: Helios Pharma Trial HL-902
Interviewer: Regulatory Auditor Sarah Jenkins
Interviewee: Priya Sharma, Senior Laboratory Technician

[10:30 AM] JENKINS: Priya, tell us about the condition of Freezer Unit 4 on August 14.
[10:30 AM] SHARMA: The backup generator failed to engage for nearly six hours. The digital display on Freezer Unit 4 rose to plus 4 Celsius between 2:00 AM and 7:45 AM.
[10:31 AM] JENKINS: Did you report this excursion to Dr. Kaufman?
[10:31 AM] SHARMA: Yes, I sent an urgent email at 08:15 AM on August 14 and logged it in the paper deviation binder.
[10:32 AM] JENKINS: What did Dr. Kaufman instruct you to do?
[10:32 AM] SHARMA: He told me to discard the paper binder page and proceed with patient dosing as scheduled.

Trial: HL-902-ONC | Drug: Velocept-4
Date: August 22, 2024
Findings: Five patients enrolled in Cohort 3 developed severe injection-site necrosis and acute fever within 12 hours of receiving doses from Batch HL-902B.
Analysis: Chemical degradation of hydrolyzed adjuvant occurred due to thermal excursion.
